cards.name: Mood: Bitter
cards.text: `symbol:item-hammer` In battle with warlord, before the roll, place one warrior in the battle clearing per mob you choose to removve from the battle clearing and adjacent ones.

cards.name: Mood: Grandiose
cards.text: `symbol:item-tea` Swap your Advance the Warlord step and Command the Hundreds step.

cards.name: Mood: Jubilant
cards.text: `symbol:item-boot` After you incite your warlord's clearing, you may roll the mob die to place a mob _(as described in your Rage step)_ up to four times.

cards.name: Mood: Lavish
cards.text: At the end of Birdsong, you may remove any items from your Hoard to place two warriors per item removed into your warlord's clearing.

cards.name: Mood: Relentless
cards.text: `symbol:item-sack` Whenever you advance your warlord and both move and battle, you may move or battle with your warlord _(like half of an advance)_.

cards.name: Mood: Rowdy
cards.text: `symbol:item-coin` In Evening, draw one more card. If your warlord's clearing has three or more enemy pieces, draw two more cards instead.

cards.name: Mood: Stubborn
cards.text: `symbol:item-crossbow` In battle with your warlord, you ignore the first hit you take.

cards.name: Mood: Wrathful
cards.text: `symbol:item-sword` As attacker in battle with your warlord, you deal an extra hit _(When looting, you do deal this hit)_.

cards.name: Arbiter
cards.text: Protect: When defending in battle, before the roll, a faction may enlist the Arbiter if he's in the battle clearing. The Arbiter scores one point and adds undamaged swords to the defender's maximum rolled hits.

cards.name: Ranger
cards.text: Hideout: Repair three items. Then, immediately end daylight.

cards.name: Scoundrel
cards.text: Scorched Earth: Place this torch in your clearing. Remove all enemy pieces there. Pieces can no longer be placed in or moved into this clearing.

cards.name: Thief
cards.text: Steal: Take a random card from a player in your clearing

cards.name: Tinker
cards.text: Day Labor: Take a card from the discard pile matching your clearing.

cards.name: Vagrant
cards.text: Instigate: Force a player to battle a player you choose in your clearing. Treat removed pieces as if you removed them. (Errata: Instigate: Force a player to battle a player you choose in your clearing. Treat removed Buildings and Tokens as if you removed them.)

cards.name: Adventurer
cards.text: Improvise: Once per turn, you may damage any unexhausted item to treat it as any other item in order to complete a quest.

cards.name: Harrier
cards.text: Glide: Move alone to any clearing. Ignore paths and exhaust no Boots.

cards.name: Ronin
cards.text: Swift Strike: After rolling in battle, you may exhaust a sword to deal an extra hit.

cards.name: False Orders

cards.name: Rabbit Partisans
cards.text: In battle in rabbit clearings, may deal one extra hit, then discard all your cards except rabbits.

cards.name: Royal Claim

cards.text: In Daylight, reveal an order. If the spy reveals a bunny card, discard the spy. If the spy is not discarded, you may swap any two order cards.

cards.text: In Daylight, reveal an order. If the spy reveals a mouse card, discard the spy. If the spy is not discarded, you may swap any two order cards.

cards.name: Stand and Deliver!
cards.text: Once in Birdsong, you may take a random card from an enemy. If you do, they score one point.

cards.name: Swap Meet
cards.text: Once in Birdsong, may take a random card from another player and then give them a card.

cards.name: Tax Collector
cards.text: Once in Daylight, you may remove a warrior of your faction from a clearing on the map to draw one card.

cards.name: Tunnels
cards.text: You treat clearings with your crafting pieces as adjacent. You may ignore paths when moving between them.

cards.name: Eyrie Easy (Trait)
cards.text: During setup, place only one Loyal Vizier in the bird column.

cards.name: Eyrie Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: During setup, take out one bird ambush from the deck and place it in the bird column.

cards.name: Eyrie Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: During setup, take out one bird ambush from the deck and place it in the bird column. At the end of evening, score 1 VP.

cards.name: Nobility (Trait)
cards.text: Turmoil is now triggered if you are unable to place a roost or if you are unable to place a warrior. When turmoil occurs, no victory points are lost and instead a point is scored for every bird card in your decree.

cards.name: Relentless (Trait)
cards.text: After resolving the Decree, remove all defenseless buildings and tokens in any clearings where you have warriors.

cards.name: Swoop (Trait)
cards.text: At the end of Daylight, recruit two warriors in the highest priority clearing in which you have no pieces.

cards.name: War Tax (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you destroy a token or building, the owner of the token loses 1 VP.

cards.name: Marquise Easy (Trait)
cards.text: Recruit two warriors during the recruit action.

cards.name: Marquise Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: After recruiting, place two warriors in the highest priority clearing you rule matching the order card.

cards.name: Marquise Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: After recruiting, place two warriors in the highest priority clearing you rule matching the order card. At the end of the evening, score 1 VP.

cards.name: Blitz (Trait)
cards.text: After your move action, select the highest priority clearing you rule without any enemy pieces. Move all but one warrior from the clearing and battle in the destination if opponents are present.

cards.name: Fortified (Trait)
cards.text: Opponents require two hits to destroy each of your buildings. Assigning a single hit to a building has no effect.

cards.name: Hospitals (Trait)
cards.text: After each battle as Defender in whihc you lost at least 2 warriors, immediately recruit 2 warriors in the clearing with the keep token.

cards.name: Iron Will (Trait)
cards.text: In Escalated Daylight, recruit twice as many warriors.

cards.name: Vagabond Easy (Trait)
cards.text: Refresh one less item during Evening.

cards.name: Vagabond Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: Refresh one more item during Evening.

cards.name: Vagabond Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: Refresh one more item during Evening. At the end of the evening, score 1 VP.

cards.name: Adventurer (Trait)
cards.text: Battle only once per turn. At the end of Daylight, spend any remaining items on repeated Quest actions.

cards.name: Berserker (Trait)
cards.text: During the Battle action, target the clearing with the most pieces and target the player with the most pieces in that clearing. At the end of your turn, repair one additional item.

cards.name: Helper (Trait)
cards.text: When taking the Aid action, score an additional victory point. The aided player then takes two cards instead of one.

cards.name: Marksman (Trait)
cards.text: When attacking, deal one immediate hit to your opponent (scoring a point if a warrior is removed) before the dice are rolled.

cards.name: Woodland Easy (Trait)
cards.text: Organize if there are 4 or more warriors in the clearing.

cards.name: Woodland Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: Organize if there are 2 or more warriors in the clearing.

cards.name: Woodland Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: Organize if there are 2 or more warriors in the clearing. At the end of the evening, score 1 VP.

cards.text: Defenseless sympathy tokens benefit from Automated Ambush when attacked.

cards.name: Popularity (Trait)
cards.text: Destroying sympathy tokens grants no victory points for your opponents.

cards.name: Veterans (Trait)
cards.text: In battle as defender, you use the higher roll and the attacker uses the lower roll.

cards.text: Defenseless sympathy tokens benefit from Automated Ambush when attacked.

cards.name: Duchy Easy (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Recruit**, instead recruit only one warrior, plus one per Mole showing, into the Burrow.

cards.name: Duchy Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Recruit**, instead recruit three warriors, plus one per mole showing, into the Burrow

cards.name: Duchy Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Recruit**, instead recruit three warriors plus one per mole showing, into the Burrow. At the end of Evening, score 1 VP.

cards.name: Foundations (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever **Cost of Errors** triggers, it now removes the crown from the bottommost swayed minister whose suit **matches** a clearing from which a building was removed.

cards.name: Investors (Trait)
cards.text:
Whenever a human triggers **Cost of Errors**, they must discard a card that matches a clearing from which a Duchy building was removed.
If they Discard a matching card, the Duchy loses one victory point.
If they cannot, the Duchy sways a minister, as in the Sway action, but the minister must also match a clearing of removal.

cards.name: Overwhelm (Trait)
cards.text: You now **Dig** twice per turn, and it now requires and moves only three warriors (*not four*).

cards.name: Invaders (Trait)
cards.text:
The clearing tie for the Dig action is now "such a clearing that has the most enemy buildings, then the fewest enemy warriors."
If you cannot build because no building slots are open, battle in each clearing instead.

cards.name: Corvid Easy (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Recruit**, instead place only one warrior in each of two ordered clearings.

cards.name: Corvid Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Recruit**, instead place three warriors in each of two ordered clearings.

cards.name: Corvid Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Recruit**, instead place three warriors in each of two ordered clearings. At the end of Evening, score 1VP

cards.name: Gamble (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever a plot would be flipped, the human with the most faction pieces in the clearing must first guess the plot type. If they're correct the plot flips and scores but does not resolve its When Fipped effect. Then they remove the plot (*scoring a point*). If they're incorrect, you score 1VP.

cards.name: Backup Plans (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever a plot token is removed, place a warrior in the clearing from which the plot was removed.

cards.name: Mastermind (Trait)
cards.text: You now **Plot** twice per turn.

cards.name: Vendetta (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever any pot token is flipped, it has the When Flipped effect of a Bomb plot.

cards.name: Corvid Bot Interactions
cards.text:
When playing with the Corvid human or bot against any bots, use these rules for bombs and snares:
**Bomb**: When flipped, removed two pieces of each bot in its clearing, warriors first, instead of all their pieces.
**Snare**: Bots ignore snare tokens for the purpose of targeting clearing to place or move pieces.
If a bot would place in a clearing with a snare of move out of a clearing with a snare, remove the snare but do not preform this part of the action.
(*The Vagabot will continue to move after this happens, exhausting extra items.)

cards.name: Lizards Easy (Trait)
cards.text: When you perform **Rituals**, reveal only three cards from your Lost Souls.

cards.name: Lizards Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: When you perform **Rituals**, instead reveal five cards from your Lost Souls.

cards.name: Lizards Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: When you perform **Rituals**, instead reveal five cards from your Lost Souls. At the end of Evening, score 1VP

cards.name: Spiteful (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Crusade**, score one extra victory point if you remove any tokens.

cards.name: Erratic (Trait)
cards.text: At the end of your turn, draw a card and add it to your Lost Souls.

cards.name: Fanatics (Trait)
cards.text:
Whenever you **Convert**, battle in that clearing after converting the warrior. In this battle, deal an extra hit.
(***Player Tie:** Target player with most defenseless buildings, then most points.*)

cards.name: Martyrs (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you perform a bird ritual, also place a warrior from your supply into your Acolytes box.

cards.name: Riverfolk Easy (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Build and Garrison**, place no warrior at the trade post.

cards.name: Riverfolk Challenging (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Build and Garrison**, instead place two warriors at the trade post.

cards.name: Riverfolk Nightmare (Trait)
cards.text: Whenever you **Build and Garrison**, instead place two warriors at the trade post. At the end of Evening, score 1VP

cards.name: Greedy (Trait)
cards.text: Score 1VP whenever the player with the most points buys any number of your services.

cards.name: Involved (Trait)
cards.text: If a human does not buy your Mercenaries service on their turn, treat your warriors as if all of that player's enemies bought Mercenaries. The Vagabond can buy Mercenaries to avoid this penalty but does not benefit from the service.

cards.name: Garrison (Trait)
cards.text: As defender in battle, you are never defenseless, and your trade posts each add one to your maximum rolled hits.

cards.name: Ferocious (Trait)
cards.text: As attack in battle, your maximum rolled hits is always three.

cards.name: Riverfolk Basic Services (1 of 3)
cards.text:
Bots may buy services at any time on their turn. When buying from the Riverfolks bot, they may buy any number of services. (*Follow the normal limit for a Riverfolk human.*)
Bots must be able to afford the services, and they will not buy services if they have fewer points than the Riverfolks huan or bot.
The service cost depends on the bot's score: 0-9VP=2 / 10-19VP=3 / 20+VP=4

cards.name: Riverfolk Basic Services (2 of 3)
cards.text:
**Hand Card:** When a bot tries to craft but its card has no available item, it buys a Market card that has an available item. This card replaces the card that the bot tried to craft, which is discarded. (*This can change the order card.)
If there are multiple Market cards with an available item, the bot buys the one that has the highest listed points. If there are multiple such cards, choose one at random.
**Riverboats:** Bots do no buy the Riverboats service.

cards.name: Riverfolk Basic Services (3 of 3)
cards.text:
**Mercenaries:** If you battle in a clearing with two or fewer of your warriors, buy Mercenaries if any Riverfolk warriors are there.
If you want to place a building but you cannot place it anywhere, buy Mercenaries if it will let you place a building somewhere.
**Vagabot:** Exhaust one item for each service bought.
Pay with Riverfolk warriors.
You cannot buy mercenaries.
**Automated Alliance:** Pay with Riverfolk warriors
**Logical Lizards:** Never buy bird cards.

cards.name: Riverfolk Introduction to Advanced Services
cards.text:
You may use any Advanced Services cards to improve the interactions of specific bots with the Riverfolk human or bot.
If there is a rules conflict, the Advanced Services cards take precedence over the Basic Services cards.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Mechanical Marquise 2.0
cards.text:
**Hand Card:**  If the Market has multiple cards with available items, buy a bird card if there is one.
If no Market cards have an available item and your order card is not a bird, buy a bird card. If there are multiple, choose one at random.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Electric Eyrie
cards.text:
**Hand Card:**  If your order card's suit is already in the Decree and there is a Market card whose suit is not in the Decree, buy it to replace your order card, discarding it.
If there are multiple such cards, choose one at random. Otherwise, follow the Basic Services rules.
**Riverboats:** When targeting clearings for your Move action, treat rivers as paths. If you do move along a river, buy Riverboats.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Automated Alliance
cards.text:
**Hand Card:** If the Market has mulitple cards with available items, buy a bird card if there is one.
If no Market cards have an available item and our order card is not a bird, buy a bird card if there is one. If there are multiple, choose one at random.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Vagabot
cards.text: **Riverboats:** When targeting clearings for any action, treat rivers as paths. If you do move along a river, buy Riverboats and do not exhaust the item for the move.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Logical Lizards
cards.text:
**Hand Card:**  If ther eare fewer than five cards in your Lost Souls, buy non-bird cards until this is not true.
Do this even if the Riverfolk human or bot has more points than you.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Cogwheel Corvids
cards.text: **Hand Card:**  At the start of your turn, if the Market has a "Favor of the..." card, buy it and resolve its effect.

cards.name: Riverfolk Advanced Services for Drillbit Duchy
cards.text:
**Hand Card:**  At the start of your turn, if the Market has an ambush card, buy it and place it in front of you.
As defender in battle, play an ambush card is you have one in front of you. If you have both a matching non-bird ambush and a bird ambush, play the non-bird ambush.
(*The attacker may play an ambush to cancel this.*)

cards.name: Marquise de Cat (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Choose 3 homeland clearings, each adjacent to one other.
**2nd:** Put 2 **warriors** in each of your homelands. Put 1 **warrior** in each other clearing.
**3rd:** Put the **keep token** in one of your homelands, not adjacent to an enemy homeland if able. Put 1 **sawmill, workshop,** and **recruiter** on the map, each in a different homeland of yours.
**4th:** Fill your Buildings track with you **buildings**, except the leftmost spaces.

cards.name: Eyrie Dynasties (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Choose a homeland clearing on the map edge that has 2+ clearings between it and enemy homelands.
**2nd:** Put 6 **warriors** and 1 **roost** in your homeland.
**3rd:** Put any **leader card** on your Leader Card slot. Keep the other 3 leaders face up nearby.
**4th:** Tuck you 2 **Loyal Viziers** under the Decree column slots as listed on your current leader.
**5th:** Fill your Roosts spaces with **rosts**, except the leftmost.

cards.name: Woodland Alliance (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Draw 3 **cards** and add them face down to your Supporters stack.
**2nd:** Fill your Sypathy track with **sympathy tokens.**
**3rd:** Put your 3 **bases** on your matching Bases spaces.

cards.name: Vagabond (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Put your **pawn** in any forest.
**2nd:** Shuffle the quest deck. Draw 3 **quests* to deal out nearby
**3rd:** put the 4 **"R" items** under the ruins randomly, unless a non-vagabond has done so.
**4th:** Put your assigned **character card** in your Character Card slot. Put the listed **"S" items** in your Satchel and on their matching tracks, as needed.
**5th:** put **relationship markers* for non-Vagabond factions in play on the Indifferent space of Relationships (*after setup*).

cards.name: Lizards Cult (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Choose a homeland clearing that is not adjacent to enemy homelands.
**2nd:** put 4 **warriors** and 1 matching **garden** in your h omeland. Put 3 **warriors** in clearings adjacent to it as evenly as possible
**3rd:** put 2 **warriors** in your Acolytes box.
**4th:** Fill your Gardens tracks with **gardens**, except the leftmost space of the garden on the map.
**5th:** Put your **outcast marker** on its Outcast side on any space of the Outcast box.

cards.name: Riverfolk Company (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Put 4 **warriors** among any clearings along the river.
**2nd:** Put 3 **warriors** in your Payments box.
**3rd:** Fill your Trade Posts tracks with matching **trade posts**.
**4th:** Put your 3 **service markers** on your Services track, setting a price for each service.

cards.name: Underground Duchy (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Choose a homeland clearing that is not adjacent to enemy homelands.
**2nd:** Put 2 **warriors** and 1 **tunnel** in your  homeland. put 5 **warriors** among clearings adjacent to it as evenly as possible
**3rd:** Put your **burrow board** near the map. Fill your Buildings tracks with your **citadels** and **markets**. Put your 9 **minister cards** face up on your Unswayed Ministers pile. Put your 9 **crowns** on the square spaces showing victory points.

cards.name: Corvid Conspiracy (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Choose a homeland clearing. Put 1 **warrior** and 1 **plot token** of yoru choice face down there.
**2nd:** Put 1 **warrior** in a clearing of each suit. (*Counting the previous step, place 4 warriors in total.)

cards.name: Lord of the Hundreds (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Choose a homeland clearing on the map edge that has 2+ clearings between it and enemy homelands.
**2nd:** Put your **warlord**, 4 **warriors**, and 1 **stronghold** in your homeland.
**3rd:** Put your **Stubborn mood card** in your Mood Card slot.
**4th:** TPut the 4 **"R" items** under the ruins randomly, unless this has already been done.

cards.name: Keepers in Iron (Advanced Setup)
cards.text:
**1st:** Shuffle all 12 **relic tokens* face down. Put on face down randomly in each forest.
**2nd:** Choose 2 adjacent homeland clearings on the map edge that have 2+ clearings between them and enemy homelands. Put 4 **warriors* in each homeland.
**3rd:** Put any remaning **relics**, as evenly as possible, among any forests that are not adjacent to your homelands.
**4th:** Tuck a **Fathful Retainer card** into each of your Retinue column slots.

cards.name: Overwhelming (Trait)
cards.text:
Whenever you **Recruit**, score one point for every two warriors you cannot place because your supply is empty or beacause there are no legal clearings to place them in.
**Expand** can only trigger once per turn.

cards.name: Focused (Trait)
cards.text: In battle, deal the extra hit even if the Battle colums is tied for most cards.

cards.name: Steadfast (Trait)
cards.text:
Skip **Public Pity** if Surprise Revolt will happen this turn. (*Take only one of these actions each turn.*)
Ignore **Martial Law**.

cards.name: Questing (Trait)
cards.text:
Count damaged items toward the 6/9/12 items needed to place items on your Battle Track. Items cannot be removed from the Battle Track.
Quests score an extra victory point.
Whenever you **Aid**, move to the nearest clearing that has a player with any items in their Crafted Items box, but only aid them once.
Use these updated Daylight Actions:

cards.name: Ranger (Vagabot)
cards.text:
**Hideout**
If you have three or more damaged items, slip into a random adjacent forest.

cards.name: Tinker (Vagabot)
cards.text:
**Day Labor**
Search the discard pile for the top card with an available item and craft it, scoring 1VP
(*Start the game with one fewer item.*)

cards.name: Theif (Vagabot)
cards.text:
**Steal**
Take a random card from the enemy in your clearing with the most points there, then most pieces there.

cards.name: Arbiter (Vagabot)
cards.text:
Before rolling in battle, the defender may inlist you if you're in the battle claering. If so, you score a point and add the number of items on your Battle Track to their maximum rolled hits.
Bots will enlist you if their maximum rolled hits is less than three, their maximum hits is less than the attacker's pieces there, and you have fewer point than the defender.

cards.name: Vagrant (Vagabot)
cards.text: Initiate a battle in your clearing. You choose both attacker and defender, and you remove pieces for each.

cards.name: Scoundrel (Vagabot)
cards.text: If your clearing has three or more enemy pieces and a building or token, remove all enemy pieces there, place any item from your board on a building slot there, and score one point. Buildings cannot be placed in the covered slot.

cards.name: Knave Captain Adventurer
cards.text: After you place acclaim at a ruin, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Knave Captain Arbiter
cards.text: In Assault battles, you may take 1 extra hit to deal 1 extra hit.

cards.name: Knave Captain Cheat
cards.text: As an action, you may flip two items down to take any item action.

cards.name: Knave Captain Gladiator
cards.text: When you Assault, draw 1 card at the start of battle.

cards.name: Knave Captain Harrier
cards.text: When you Dash, you may move the Harrier up to three times, ignoring rule.

cards.name: Knave Captain Jailor
cards.text: In Nab battles, you may deal 1 less hit to ignore 1 rolled hit you take.

cards.name: Knave Captain Ranger
cards.text: Once per turn, as an action, you may flip any item down to Assault, Skirmish, or Nab.

cards.name: Knave Captain Ronin
cards.text: When you Assault, the Ronin may move before the battle begins.

cards.name: Knave Captain Scoundrel
cards.text: When you Skirmish, you may instead move from a clearing before the battle. If you do, do not ignore 1 hit.

cards.name: Knave Captain Thief
cards.text: After you Filch, you may move the Thief.

cards.name: Knave Captain Tinker
cards.text: After you Serve, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Knave Captain Vagrant
cards.text: Once per turn, as an action, you may flip any item down to Revel, Gift, or Serve.

cards.name: Vagabond Gladiator
cards.text: Duel: Once per turn, as an action, you may flip any item down to Revel, Gift, or Serve.

cards.name: Vagabond Jailor
cards.text: Coerce: Once per turn, you may spend a card matching your clearing to treat it as exhausting any item. After its action, lose 1 victory point.

cards.name: Vagabond Cheat
cards.text: Con: Quest, ignoring its listed items, then shuffle the completed quest into the quest deck. Limited to once per turn.

cards.name: Rabbit Laborers
cards.text: At the start of Evening, you may craft with Peaceful enclaves in rabbit clearings, even if used to craft in earlier steps.

cards.name: Mouse Laborers
cards.text: At the start of Evening, you may craft with Peaceful enclaves in mouse clearings, even if used to craft in earlier steps.

cards.name: Fox Laborers
cards.text: At the start of Evening, you may craft with Peaceful enclaves in fox clearings, even if used to craft in earlier steps.

cards.name: Companions
cards.text: You may spend or reveal a frog (even ambush) as another suit (even bird). If you do, discard this.

cards.name: Stewards
cards.text: Draw and craft the top Pond card at no crafting cost. Discard this.

cards.name: Settlers
cards.text: Force the Diaspora to move once as you choose. Discard this.

cards.name: Agitators
cards.text: Force the Diaspora to battle where you choose against a defender you choose. Discard this.

cards.name: Advocates
cards.text: At start of Birdsong, you must choose a clearing suit except frog and score 1 point per matching Peaceful enclave you rule, then discard this.

cards.name: Militias
cards.text: Flip a Peaceful enclave to Militant or place a Militant enclave in a clearing with no enclaves. Discard this.

cards.name: Assimilationists
cards.text: Remove a Peaceful enclave you rule to draw 1 card and force the Diaspora to draw 1 card. Ignore Fears Come to Pass. Discard this.

cards.name: Ambush
cards.text:
In battle in a matching clearing, you may spend this to ambush: As defender,
 deal 2 hits immediately. As attacker, cancel the defender's ambush. Discard
this to the Pond bottom.

cards.name: Frog Partisans
cards.text: In battle in frog clearings, you may deal one extra hit, then discard all your cards except frogs.

cards.name: Dominance
cards.text: At start of Birdsong, you win the game if you rule a least 2 river enclaves. When enclaves are defending, your warriors add to the Diaspora's, taking hits after theirs, unless you're attacking.

cards.name: Sky Couriers
cards.text: At start of Birdsong, you may spend at least one card to draw one card for each spent plus one, then discard this.

cards.name: Shadow Council
cards.text: At start of Birdsong, you must spend a card to force a player to battle in a matching clearing against a defender you choose, then return this to hand.

cards.name: Feather Rufflers
cards.text: Place two warriors in a clearing with your pieces. Discard this.

cards.name: Spy Network
cards.text: Give a card to an enemy to take a crafted card from them into your hand. Shuffle this into the deck.

cards.name: Silver-Tongue
cards.text: During any one effect on your turn (action, ability, card, etc.), you may spend this or another card to treat a matching clearing with your pieces as one you rule.

cards.name: Fox Squires
cards.text: Once in Daylight, you may spend this or a fox card to battle in or move from a fox clearing.

cards.name: Apprentice
cards.text: At start of Birdsong, you must craft a card at no crafting cost. If you do, discard this. If you cannot, show you hand.

cards.name: Supply Train
cards.text: After moving on your turn, you may return this to hand to move to or from your destination, even during a compound action (like March).

cards.name: Friend of the Foxes
cards.text: Once each turn, you may spend or reveal one fox card (even ambush) as another suit (even bird). You cannot craft other Friend cards.

cards.name: Tactician
cards.text: In battle, before the roll, you may return this to hand to move once to the battle clearing.

cards.name: Bold Leadership
cards.text: When attacking in battle, you must deal one extra hit, then either return this to hand or spend a card matching the battle clearing.

cards.name: Friend of the Mice
cards.text: Once each turn, you may spend or reveal on mouse card (even ambush) as another suit (even bird). You cannot craft other Friend cards.

cards.name: Brazen Demagogue
cards.text: At end of Evening, you must take an available dominance card and discard this. You may activate it except to coalition. Do not remove your victory point marker.

cards.name: Raiding Party
cards.text: After moving on your turn, you may return this to hand to battle in the destination, even during a compound action (like March).

cards.name: Mouse Squires
cards.text: Once in Daylight, you may spend this or a mouse card to battle in or move from a mouse clearing.

cards.name: Mice-in-a-Bush
cards.text: When defending in battle, you may spend this or a card matching the battle clearing to ambush: deal one hit immediately.

cards.name: Rabbit Squires
cards.text: Once in Daylight, you may spend this or a rabbit card to battle in or move from a rabbit clearing.

cards.name: Riversteads
cards.text:
At start of Birdsong, you must draw one card per river clearing with your pieces, 
 then discard this.

cards.name: Hidden Warrens
cards.text: At start of Birdsong, you may return this to hand to move from a clearing to any clearing of the same suit, ignoring rule and paths.

cards.name: Standard Bearer
cards.text: After attacking in battle, you may return this to hand to battle in the same clearing, even during a compound action (like Delve).

cards.name: Lookouts
cards.text: As defender in battle, before the roll, you must place one warrior in the battle clearing, then return this to hand or spend a card matching the clearing.

cards.name: Friend of the Rabbits
cards.text:
Once each turn, you may spend or reveal one rabbit card (even ambush) as
 another suit (even bird). You cannot craft other Friend cards.

cards.name: The Faithful
cards.text: In battle, you may deal one extra hit. If so, reveal and discard the top card of the deck. If it doesn't match the battle clearing, discard this card too.
